title: "Canadian consumers have something Americans don't."
summary: Trump’s attempt to intimidate Canada and Prime Minister Mark Carney are destined to backfire — even if Canada might suffer in the short-term. It’s a betrayal of what’s made America work over the past 80 years, according to Scott Galloway and Jessica Tarlov on Raging Moderates.
